Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
The trail splits around a boulder and rejoins — the world's oldest traffic decision. You follow the deeper-worn side.
You see smoke on the horizon. Thornfield — 10 people, 5 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — A person, maybe 40s, with sun-creased eyes telling A woman, maybe 60s about themself. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Fallen trunks lie like sleeping animals, furred with moss. The ground gives underfoot — centuries of leaf-mold.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
A woodpecker works somewhere you can't see. Down here it smells of mushrooms and cold shade.
The stripes flowing where no wind blows stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
Movement — a waddling porcupine, quills rattling softly.
👁 Never grab it barehanded. A bow works clean; hands get quills. Flip it with a long stick if you must.
You see smoke on the horizon. Stonebridge — 9 people, 5 days in. foragers, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
Thornfield's clearing. Voices, a cookfire, somebody else's home. You're a guest here — act like it.
